ModMetaData.name: Skylights
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Bring real daylight into a roofed room.
A skylight is a reinforced transparent panel you set into a ceiling. It channels the actual sky above straight down onto the floor below, so crops grow and colonists work by natural light without a watt of power.
--- HOW IT WORKS --- The light follows the real sun. It is strong at midday, fades through dusk, and goes dark at night, so a skylit grow room keeps the same day/night rhythm as an open field. Eclipses and heavy storms dim it just as they dim the sky outside.
Because it needs the open sky, a skylight only works under a normal constructed or thin-rock roof. Set one under overhead mountain and no light gets through the solid rock.
--- USING IT --- Research Skylights, then build them into your grow rooms and workshops like ceiling tiles. They are walkable, draw no power, and never overheat a room the way a sun lamp does. Space several across a large room for even coverage, or drop a single one over a small indoor garden.
The trade-off against a sun lamp is honest: free and cool, but only as bright as the day outside, and dark every night.
Safe to add or remove mid-save.
